reason: Both submitted CIFs parse as primitive P21, Z=2, fully occupied Co3OF5 cells with 18 expanded atoms, the stated metrics, no overlaps, and plausible complete Co-anion octahedra; the determinant-3 monoclinic indexing is also strong (25/25 indexed lines, M(20) about 67). Exact atom-coordinate recovery is nevertheless not established. No external comparable score is available, the trace's Le Bail result is not a credible lower bound (it is worse than the atomic fits), and the best submitted full-profile fits remain far above point noise (Rwp about 10.55-10.62%, RMS about 0.32 versus about 0.10 noise; weak/superstructure R about 88-92%). More decisively, the grouped integrated-amplitude comparison after coordinate refinement still misses multiple low-angle superstructure reflections by factors of roughly 1.5-3 (notably near 19.65, 21.84, 22.49, 24.41, 29.40, and 31.41 degrees). The coordinates came from one rutile-derived prototype construction under strong distance restraints rather than convergent independent maps, and an omitted third concrete P21 O/F-ordering class remained comparably competitive in the trace (including a multistart amplitude cost slightly better than the submitted primary in one test); lower-symmetry orderings were not comparably refined. Another attempt is therefore likely to add a materially different viable ordered realization or materially revise the coordinates.
